IC.AddSub.foldAddWithConstant.L902: w ≠ 1 ∨ nsw = false: the add isn't an i1 or has no nsw. With nsw at i1 the rewrite is wrong: add nsw (xor %p, true), true is true for %p = true, and sub nsw false, %p is poison. Peephole.IC.visitAdd.sound discharges it, since simplifyAddInst, which visitAdd calls first, answers for every i1 add

delegates.simplifyXorInst: simplifyAddInst's step for an i1 add, through Peephole.IS.simplifyAddInst
delegates.ConstantFoldBinaryOpOperands: simplifyAddInst on two constants, through Peephole.IS.simplifyAddInst
delegates.simplifyAssociativeBinOp: simplifyAddInst on an add operand, through Peephole.IS.simplifyAddInst
delegates.SimplifyAssociativeOrCommutative: where it may change the add: the operands out of complexity order, a symmetric pair, or an add operand, which it reassociates when InstSimplify, not modelled here, simplifies part of it
delegates.foldBinopWithPhiOperands: two add operands, which may be recurrences, or two phis
delegates.foldUsingDistributiveLaws: a mul or shl-by-constant operand with the other not a constant, or a select operand
delegates.foldBoxMultiply: an even width with a shl operand and a mul one
delegates.factorizeMathWithShlOps: two shls by one amount, one with one use
delegates.foldBinOpIntoSelectOrPhi: a select or phi operand 0, with a constant operand 1
delegates.foldBinOpSelectBinOp: a select operand 0, with a constant operand 1
delegates.visitAdd: the rest of visitAdd, from foldNoWrapAdd on, unless both operands are different arguments or constants wider than i1, where none of its steps fires
